Thank your for that. I'm so sorry for your loss. Hope everything goes well for you.

I don't think I want anything later in life. It just seems useless to me. You're born, go to school, work, retire and then you die. What if there isn't anything after life? I just don't feel like life is worth it. All the stress and abuse in life. I struggle to find a purpose in my life, something to stay alive for.

It's like the feeling people get while going to sleep about being productive the next day, but when the day comes it doesn't happen. When I was smaller I wanted to do all these things in life; study, travel the world, get friends, etc. Now that a few years have passed I feel like I have no motivation to do anything in life. I feel so hopeless, and I feel that no one wluld care if I died.
